items.question: What skill level do I need for mentoring?
items.answer: You can be at any level - junior, mid-level, or even senior. I adapt the mentoring to your level. Maybe you're just starting programming, or switching to a new technology, or preparing for a leadership role. Everyone is at a different stage, and that's okay.

items.question: How much time do I need to study per week?
items.answer: It completely depends on your pace. Generally, 10-15 hours of practice per week is recommended for best results, but if you have less time, we can work with that too. The key is consistency, not quantity.

items.question: When will I see the first results?
items.answer: You'll notice progress in your knowledge and approach within the first weeks. After 3 months, you'll see significant changes in your skills and confidence. Many find new jobs within 3-6 months.

items.question: Is the mentoring online?
items.answer: Yes, everything is online, so you can join from anywhere. We use video calls (Google Meet / Zoom), code sharing tools (VS Code Live Share), and other online tools. Flexible scheduling.

items.question: Do you help with job search too?
items.answer: Yes! The Pro package includes job search support. I help with LinkedIn profile optimization, CV building, cover letter writing, and interview preparation. We also hold mock interviews.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes, both packages can be canceled anytime, no long-term commitment. Monthly subscription system, so you can decide flexibly. If you feel we've achieved the goals or want to go in a different direction, no problem.
